title: sre oncall scratchpad - 2026-03-10
content:
06:15 - Pre-shift checks
- PagerDuty clear. No unresolved high sev incidents.
- Quick health checks: alerting stack (Prometheus+Alertmanager) online.
- Confirmed SLO dashboards load (latency, error rate, qps).
- Noted incident backlog (see JIRA-SRE-341) - prioritize after morning incidents.

07:02 - Paging: PD-8921 - increased 5xx on hosted-api-us-east
- Initial alert: spike in 5xx across two frontends behind lb-us-east-1c.
- Affected endpoints: /v1/generate (text), /v1/chat/stream (timeouts).
- My notes: started triage, checked deploys and infra.
- Actions taken:
  - 07:05: Rollback recent frontend deploy (deploy/hosted-api v2.8.3 -> v2.8.2) per rollback playbook.
  - 07:08: Scaled up frontend pool by +4 instances (temporary).
  - 07:12: Notified infra (Priya) to check load balancer health checks and connection resets.
  - 07:20: Error rate dropped but some 504s persisted.
  - 07:35: Identified unhealthy upstream (model-worker-34) returning 502 intermittently. Added to drain.
  - 07:45: Traffic stabilized; resumed normal error rates.
- Post-incident TODO: add more granular logging around upstream connection resets (see runbook link). Create JIRA SRE-341 for follow-up.

08:30 - Post-incident notes (PD-8921)
- Root cause hypothesis: subtle regression in v2.8.3 that changed connection timeout handling with pooled workers leading to upstream 502 -> frontend 504 cascade.
- Immediate mitigation: rollback and scale which removed pressure.
- Next steps:
  - Reproduce in staging with load test (owner: Priya).
  - Add guard in deploy pipeline to run a lightweight smoke test for pooled worker connection behavior (owner: Ryan).
  - Add metric for upstream connection resets and alert if > X/min (owner: Noah).

09:05 - Ongoing monitoring
- Keeping an eye on host metrics: connection resets, worker memory usage, open file descriptors.
- Scheduled a follow-up async AAR in #eng-sre channel by EOD.

09:45 - Nightly cron job failure noticed (non-prod)
- Named job: infra/kv-cache compact (cron-kv-compact). Failing with OOM on k8s job.
- Logged as low-sev, created JIRA SRE-342 to diagnose memory profile.
- Quick mitigation: increase job resources for next run.

Runbook TODOs / follow-ups (priority ordered):
- [P0->P1] Add lightweight smoke test in CI to catch v2.8.x connection timeout regressions (owner: Ryan) - due 2026-03-17.
- Instrument upstream connection reset metric + Alert (owner: Noah) - due 2026-03-12.
- Load test reproducer in staging for pooled worker scenario (owner: Priya) - due 2026-03-14.
- Update deploy rollback checklist to include immediate scale-up as temporary mitigation (owner: eng-sre lead) - due 2026-03-20.
- Postmortem draft for PD-8921 (owner: Ryan) - start today, circulate to Priya & Noah.
- Investigate cron job memory usage for cron-kv-compact (owner: Priya) - link to JIRA-SRE-342.

Personal quick notes / commands used:
- kubectl -n hosted-api get pods -o wide (check pod restarts)
- kubectl -n hosted-api logs <pod> --previous | grep "connection reset"
- curl -v https://hosted-us-east.redwood.ai/v1/generate - check timeouts
- pg_dump ... (not relevant here but left as reference)

Escalations / people to contact:
- Priya Shah (infra lead) - high priority for reproducer + cluster health checks.
- Noah Chen (observability) - metrics/alerting work.
- Eng oncall rotation: check next shift handoff note.

Handoff notes for next oncall (evening)
- Incident PD-8921 was resolved via rollback to v2.8.2 + scale; watch for reappearance after 2026-03-11 deploy window.
- JIRA-SRE-341 created for follow-up; assigned to Priya.
- Keep an eye on upstream worker memory and connection resets; alert thresholds may need tuning.

Other loose items / reminders:
- Update runbook: add explicit step to drain unhealthy model-worker pods and re-route traffic.
- Check cost impact of increased scaling during incident (ask finance for temporary spike report).
- Draft AAR: include timeline, impact, mitigation, root cause hypothesis, and action owners.

End of shift checklist:
- [x] Incident closed in PagerDuty (PD-8921)
- [x] Created JIRA-SRE-341 and SRE-342
- [ ] Start postmortem draft (in progress)
- [ ] Confirm smoke test added in CI (blocked until reproducer)

Notes to self:
- Keep runbook smaller and simpler — engineers should be able to follow without deep context.
- Double-check alert thresholds before major deploys.
- Remember to push for a canary gate that runs smoke tests against pooled-worker scenarios.

Links / refs:
- Runbook: https://redwood.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/SRE/pages/12345/kv-cache-runbook
- PD: https://redwood.pagerduty.com/incidents/PD-8921
- JIRA: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/SRE-341
